responses.spec_quote: Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.

edits.value: 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters indexed by (pc[6:0] XOR ghr[6:0]); each counter initialized to 0 (predict not-taken); on training, increment if train_taken=1 (saturate at 3) and decrement if train_taken=0 (saturate at 0); predict_taken = (counter >= 2)
